baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rebuff, future prefix, and plural verb in 78:4 reject the speakers' present stance and defer its correction to what they will know.
baseline_models.mechanism: A present failure of apprehension is answered by a future transition in which the object becomes clear to the knowers.

activation_trace.role: The branch of a thing becoming clear to its knower supplies the focus verb's movement from present non-recognition to future disclosure.

changed_reading.before: A bare prediction that they will possess information later.
changed_reading.after: A rebuff whose force lies in an impending transition from an untenable present stance to compelled clarity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future knowing in 78:4 is anchored in the focus root's branch of a mark that distinguishes and directs.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge can arrive not as an explanation but as recognition produced by an unmistakable differentiating sign.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing-mark branch makes the future knowing a recognition event in which a sign identifies what had remained unsettled.

changed_reading.before: They will mentally learn an unspecified proposition.
changed_reading.after: They will recognize the matter when its differentiating mark becomes impossible to miss.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual questioning circulates around an arriving, weighty report while the participants take divergent paths. The focus future disclosure ends that unstable discourse by making its disputed object present to the knowers.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the resolution back in the focus verb.
The reciprocal-questioning branch supplies the circulating social inquiry that has not produced settlement.
The branch of a report that arrives and is conveyed gives the disputed object an incoming, event-like character.
The branch of a momentous event supplies the report's weight and explains why its disclosure overturns the present stance.
The branch in which each party takes a different path turns disagreement into diverging routes that disclosure must terminate.

structural_cues: 78:1-3 forms one unresolved question-report-disagreement sequence immediately before the focus rebuff.
The focus clause answers a discourse problem without naming the disputed object again.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal inquiry, an arriving weighty report, divergent paths, and future disclosure; I infer that the event's arrival, rather than better debate, forces convergence. A live alternative is that they merely learn the report's content while disagreement remains socially possible.

changed_reading.before: Present ignorance will later be replaced by knowledge.
changed_reading.after: A disputed report will arrive with enough force to terminate reciprocal speculation and divergent positions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same future disclosure is sounded twice, with the second occurrence placed after a sequencing particle. The repeated clause therefore acquires a two-beat or ratcheting profile rather than behaving as a single neutral forecast.

activation_trace.role: The first disclosure branch establishes the initial future threshold in the focus ayah.
The repeated disclosure branch supplies a second threshold and intensifies the certainty or staging of realization.

structural_cues: 78:5 repeats the focus clause after ثُمَّ and adds no new lexical object of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition plus a sequencing particle; I infer staged or deepening realization. The materially live alternative is emphatic reiteration with no separate stages.

changed_reading.after: A certainty sounded in successive beats, potentially moving from initial recognition to fuller realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The world is first configured as a prepared surface stabilized by elevated solids and peg-like fixity. Later the upper enclosure opens into entrances and the same mountains are displaced into mirage. The focus mark-branch is activated by this reversal: the familiar landmarks become evidence precisely by ceasing to support familiar orientation.

activation_trace.role: The distinguishing-mark branch anchors knowing as recognition through landmarks and signs.
The branch of configuring something into a state supplies the deliberate ordering of the ordinary world.
The prepared spread branch makes the earth a stable surface of orientation.
The elevated solid mass branch supplies the world's conspicuous stable landmark.
Peg-like upright fixity turns the mountain image into a mechanism of stabilization.
The opening of what was closed begins the dismantling of the ordinary enclosure.
The branch of making something into doors converts the upper boundary into multiple passages.
The removal branch supplies active displacement of what had functioned as fixed.
The same solid landmark branch recurs at the moment its apparent stability is undone.
The water-like mirage branch changes a solid landmark into deceptive appearance and completes the reversal of orientation.

structural_cues: 78:6-7 and 78:19-20 place the same mountain referent in a stability-to-displacement reversal.
The created-order sequence precedes the appointed-Day sequence, allowing ordinary structures to become later evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies configured stability, opening boundaries, displaced mountains, and mirage; I map those structures onto the focus branch of a distinguishing landmark and infer that failed orientation produces recognition. The alternative is that the scenes demonstrate power without making landmark reversal the mechanism of knowing.

changed_reading.before: They will identify the matter by a stable sign.
changed_reading.after: They will recognize it when the world's most stable signs reverse and familiar orientation becomes impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Daily awareness is cut off in sleep and reopened with daylight; the surah then scales that recurring pattern to the severe Day and final standing. Future knowing can therefore be heard as awakening from suspended awareness into irreversible presence.

activation_trace.role: The disclosure branch supplies the return of apprehension at the end of the cessation-to-standing sequence.
The death-like sleep branch supplies a daily analogue for the loss of active awareness.
The cutting-off branch makes sleep a functional interruption rather than mere rest.
Daylight opening supplies the recurrent restoration of visibility after interruption.
The branch of a day's severe event scales the ordinary daily rhythm into an eschatological threshold.
The resurrection-and-standing branch supplies the terminal awakening in which future knowledge becomes present.

structural_cues: 78:9-11 presents a sleep-to-day rhythm before 78:17 begins the repeated Day sequence.
78:38 culminates the Day sequence with standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies daily interruption, reopened daylight, the severe Day, and standing; I infer an analogy that scales daily awakening into final disclosure. The alternative is that the daily rhythm only demonstrates beneficent ordering and does not model resurrection epistemically.

changed_reading.before: They will receive information at some later time.
changed_reading.after: They will awaken from cut-off awareness into a final standing where the matter is fully disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's unspecified future is assigned a fixed threshold: a severe Day that judicially separates, has a struck appointment, is announced by a blast, and gathers people in companies. Knowing becomes public arrival at a scheduled decision rather than private acquisition of information.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the appointed public event in the focus verb.
The branch of a severe day's event gives the future disclosure a concrete temporal scene.
The judicial separation of true from false makes disclosure decisional rather than merely descriptive.
The struck appointment branch fixes the threshold implied only vaguely by the focus future prefix.
The sending of air into an instrument supplies the event's public initiating signal.
The blast-horn branch identifies the signal as the transition into assembly.
The coming branch turns future knowledge into bodily arrival at the disclosed event.
The human-group branch makes the arrival collective and publicly witnessed.

structural_cues: 78:17 explicitly names the Day and its appointment; 78:18 immediately describes its signal and assembly.
The repeated singular Day references through 78:40 keep later scenes attached to this threshold.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed Day, judicial separation, signal, coming, and groups; I infer that these specify when and how the focus future becomes knowledge. A live alternative is that recognition begins before the assembly, with the event only confirming it.

changed_reading.before: They will know at an unspecified later point.
changed_reading.after: They will be brought publicly to a fixed decision-event whose occurrence itself supplies the knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Action is met by a matching return, despite the actors' failure to anticipate accounting; everything is exhaustively counted and made an inspectable record, then the result is experienced and increased as punishment. The focus knowing becomes an embodied audit in which record, equivalence, and consequence verify one another.

activation_trace.role: The disclosure branch anchors the audit's verification in the focus future knowing.
The branch of answering an act with its consequence supplies the audit's action-to-result relation.
The equal-to-need-or-counterpart branch makes the consequence commensurate rather than arbitrary.
The branch of the heart's expectation supplies the absent anticipation that made the audit dismissible beforehand.
Counting and accounting supply the evaluative procedure they failed to expect.
Exhaustive enumeration closes gaps through which an act might evade the audit.
The written-object branch gives the count a stable, inspectable form.
Experiencing and undergoing a thing turns the record's information into bodily verification.
The increase branch makes the experienced result cumulative rather than exhausted by one encounter.
Painful punishment supplies the concrete consequence through which the audit is finally known.

structural_cues: 78:26-30 moves from matching recompense, through denied expectation and exhaustive record, to the imperative of direct experience.
The account is presented before the command to experience its outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched recompense, failed expectation, exhaustive written count, experience, increase, and punishment; I infer that experiential consequence verifies the record and is the mechanism of knowing. The alternative is that knowledge remains cognitive while tasting is only a later penalty.

changed_reading.before: They will intellectually concede that the warning was true.
changed_reading.after: They will know through an exhaustive, commensurate audit whose recorded result is made bodily experience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible signs are actively assigned falsehood, yet the Day is fixed as reality and the final resistant subject is characterized by covering truth. Against that sequence, focus knowing is less the addition of missing data than the removal of a cover from evidence already present.

activation_trace.role: The disclosure branch anchors the uncovering movement in the focus verb.
The branch of assigning falsehood supplies the active misclassification imposed on the evidence.
The visible-sign branch supplies evidence that was marked before the future disclosure.
The branch of establishing and manifesting truth supplies the later reversal of imposed falsehood.
The covering-of-truth branch identifies concealment, rather than simple information scarcity, as the resistance disclosure defeats.

structural_cues: The denial of signs in 78:28 precedes the declaration of the true Day in 78:39 and the final naming of the resistant speaker in 78:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs, their assignment to falsehood, manifested truth, and covering; I infer a cover-to-disclosure reversal as the focus verb's mechanism. The alternative is that the covering branch names a settled identity without describing an epistemic process.

changed_reading.before: They lack knowledge that will later be supplied.
changed_reading.after: They have covered or misclassified marked evidence, and future knowing is the forced stripping away of that cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with reciprocal questioning but later removes ownership of address, permits intelligible speech only by authorization, requires speech that lands on the right, and ends with a resistant speaker's bare wish. Knowing thus changes the social regime of speech: speculative exchange contracts into licensed correctness and exposed regret.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the change in speech conditions back in the focus verb.
Reciprocal questioning supplies the initially open, horizontal speech regime.
The possession-and-disposal branch supplies the denied capacity to control address.
The exchange-of-address branch identifies the speech capacity that is no longer possessed.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the act placed under restriction.
Permission supplies the gate through which speech may now occur.
Uttered speech supplies the authorized output of the restricted regime.
Rightness settled opposite error supplies the required quality of authorized speech.
The final utterance branch reduces the former questioner to a disclosed wish rather than an argument.

structural_cues: The surah moves from a plural reciprocal question in 78:1 to negated possession of address in 78:37, restricted speech in 78:38, and one final utterance in 78:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal questioning, lost control of address, permission, right speech, and final utterance; I infer that disclosure reorganizes who may speak and what speech can do. The alternative is that these are separate audience scenes and not the social consequence of the focus knowing.

changed_reading.before: Knowing is a private cognitive correction.
changed_reading.after: Knowing closes the space of speculative exchange and leaves only authorized right speech or exposed regret.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning is brought temporally near, then the plural audience is individualized as each person directs sight toward what their own hands sent ahead. The one who covered truth can no longer externalize the issue and wishes for reduction to dust. Future knowing becomes immediate recognition of self-authored consequence.

activation_trace.role: The disclosure branch anchors direct self-recognition in the focus promise that they will know.
The warning that awakens caution supplies the prior communicated opportunity for recognition.
Temporal nearness collapses the distance left open by the focus future prefix.
Directed sight or insight supplies the immediate mode by which the consequence is apprehended.
The individual-person branch converts the plural warning into singular accountability.
Advancing something ahead supplies the temporal path by which prior acts meet their actor.
The branch of what the hands acquired identifies the viewed consequence as the person's own production.
Covering truth supplies the prior posture that direct sight can no longer maintain.
Earth and dust supply the wished-for erasure that follows inescapable self-recognition.

structural_cues: 78:40 shifts from plural warning to a singular person looking, then identifies a singular resistant speaker.
The final ayah supplies an explicit visual object for the otherwise objectless knowing of 78:4.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near warning, direct sight, an individualized person, deeds advanced by the hands, covering, and the dust-wish; I infer that seeing one's own agency is the culminating mechanism of the focus knowing. The alternative is that 78:40 illustrates only one subgroup while the earlier plural knowing has a broader object.

changed_reading.before: They will know that an external prediction was correct.
changed_reading.after: Each will recognize the near consequence as the visible return of what their own agency sent ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's form-distant branch of gathered water rather than its ordinary cognitive branch. It remains anchored in the focus root and is reinforced by a packet sequence of pressure, abundant water, pouring, and emergence from hiding. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for accumulated disclosure, never as a lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The gathered-water branch of the sole focus root permits an image in which future knowing accumulates until containment fails.

activation_trace.role: The branch of a large gathered body of water supplies latent accumulation as the outlier's focus-root anchor.
Pressure until liquid is expressed supplies the threshold that releases accumulated disclosure.
The appearance and abundance of water supplies the material being gathered and released.
Pouring and outflow convert stored pressure into an overwhelming disclosure event.
Bringing something out of concealment gives the released flow an epistemic result.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the visible consequence of what had accumulated unseen.

changed_reading.before: Future knowledge arrives as one discrete fact.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure gathers under pressure, breaks containment, and forces what was hidden into visible growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch names a visible cleft in the upper lip and is form-distant from ordinary knowing. It remains root-anchored, while the packet's restricted, permitted, and correctness-bound speech makes the mouth a coherent activation site. Downstream prose must qualify it as an embodied image of argumentative rupture, not morphology or a proposed dictionary sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The visible-cleft branch of the focus root allows future knowing to be imaged as a rupture that becomes externally legible at the organ of speech.

activation_trace.role: The visible upper-lip cleft supplies an embodied, externally readable rupture as the focus-root anchor.
Intelligible speech locates the outlier's rupture within the exchange that had carried the dispute.
Permission constrains whether the ruptured speaker can turn recognition into speech.
Utterance supplies the oral output against which the bodily image becomes legible.
Speech settled on the right side of error supplies the correction that follows rupture of the prior discourse.

changed_reading.before: Their inward judgment changes while their argumentative posture remains intact.
changed_reading.after: Recognition appears as a visible rupture in the very speech apparatus that sustained dispute, leaving speech constrained to what is permitted and right.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus root's lexical branch naming a raptor rather than a semantic branch of cognition. It remains anchored in that supplied branch and gains a coherent predator-watch mechanism from the packet's guarded ambush and watcher images. Downstream prose should carry it only as a reversal-of-gaze analogy, not as a gloss of the focus verb or an identification of any named creature in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The raptor-name branch of the focus root allows the knowers to be re-imaged as subjects caught under a superior watch.

activation_trace.role: The raptor-name branch supplies a form-distant image of a superior gaze tracking its target.
Watching and guarding supply the sustained surveillance behind the waiting destination.
The watcher branch reverses the gaze: the person who finally looks has already been under watch.

changed_reading.before: The disputants are observers trying to determine an uncertain object.
changed_reading.after: Their future knowing occurs when the gaze reverses and they discover themselves already tracked at a waiting ambush.

strongest_changes: The opening dispute becomes forced convergence when an arriving report is publicly realized.
Stable cosmic landmarks become epistemic signs by reversing into opened boundaries, displacement, and mirage.
Knowing becomes an exhaustive and commensurate audit verified through direct experience.
The final ayah specifies the culmination as each person seeing the consequence their own hands advanced.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed long mechanisms that the short focus clause suppresses: exact repetition, daily cessation scaled to final standing, created stability reversed at the appointed Day, open questioning narrowed into licensed speech, and covered signs ending in self-sight.
remaining_uncertainties: The repetition in 78:4-5 may mark successive realizations or only emphatic certainty.
The daily sleep-to-standing analogy is coherent but not explicitly stated as the mechanism of knowing.
The material and animal outliers depend on deliberately form-distant focus branches and must remain analogical.
The plural knowers may include all disputants or may narrow toward the resistant subgroup depicted at the end.
